items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Baby Dodds used to talk about him too... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that's a good drummer.

ctx.x: Oh, Mike Murray's been dead many years, yeah. Well, Mike Murray.
Baby Dodds used to talk about him too, that he inspired him. That was his favorite drummer. That's a good drummer.
